title: Going public with the find through Expressen
summary: Dennis Asberg tells of Going public with the find through Expressen, about 2011 at Stockholm, Sweden, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, I talked to a journalist here in Stockholm, Expressen is a big newspaper.

plain: A Swedish treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg says that he found something on the seafloor that he describes as looking like a UFO. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that around 2011 he went public with it by talking to a journalist at Expressen, a big newspaper in Stockholm. If his account is right, that newspaper story is how the find first reached a wider audience.
